name: Translate to Russian
description: A voice speaks what you say in Russian. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 259 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Russian model from the Argos Translate package index: Argos Translate (Aleksey Kutashov, Argos Open Technologies), released under MIT or CC0 (argos-translate issue #533). Trained on OPUS data (CCMatrix, WikiMatrix and more); includes a Stanza English tokenizer (Apache-2.0). Voice: Piper voice ru_RU-irina-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, see its model card.
